ADMIN_USERNAME.description: Login name for the hexo-admin web editor at /admin/. Password is auto-generated.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Auto-generated password for the hexo-admin editor (read it from the service's Variables tab after deploy). Login is required on /admin/.

ARTALK_SITE_DEFAULT.description: Site name used by the Artalk comment system.

ARTALK_DB_TYPE.description: Comment database: sqlite (file on the persistent volume) or pgsql/mysql/mssql (set DATABASE_URL too).

ARTALK_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Email of the first comment moderator (login at /comment/admin/). Change after deploy.

ARTALK_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Auto-generated password for the Artalk moderator account.

MINIO_ROOT_USER.description: S3 root username for the MinIO object store (endpoint /minio, console /minio-console/).

MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD.description: Auto-generated S3 root password for MinIO.

TZ.description: Timezone for the container, Hexo and Artalk (IANA name, e.g. America/New_York).
